Name: Minakie's Custom Furniture
Author: Minakie
Description:
[i][left][b][u][size=3][s][img]https://i.postimg.cc/zXgDX0nc/about-the-mod.png[/img]﻿[/s][/size][/u][/b][/left][/i]
[size=3]This mod adds new furniture to the game.
Most of them are static, but the tip jar, piggy bank and all the coffers have an animated version as well.[/size]
[size=3]
[center][/center][center]﻿
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/5072/5072-1577907441-828159490.gif[/img]﻿[/center]
These items can be obtained through the Furniture Catalogue (sold at the Carpenter's Shop).

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/Fzts1wpW/beware.png[/img]

Custom Furniture is currently outdated. You will need to [url=https://community.playstarbound.com/threads/updating-mods-for-stardew-valley-1-4.156000/page-19#post-3353793]get the unofficial update here[/url]. Also, bear in mind that, even with that version installed, it is a [u][b]known issue[/b] that the Custom Furniture will some times turn into chairs[/u] when you relaunch the game. For some people, simply going back to the Title screen and back into the game fixes this issue; for others, sadly it does not. I have a few more furniture pieces already made and coded but have been refraining to update the mod because I was still hopeful that one of the many talented people in our modding community could come up with a more permanent fix for this issue.

[b][u]Updated[/u][/b]: Routine shared an unofficial update [url=https://discordapp.com/channels/137344473976799233/156109690059751424/669009215184044042]on the SV Discord[/url] that might fix the issue of the chairs. It's still in the testing phase, but you might wanna give it a try.


[u][b][b][u][img]https://i.postimg.cc/d0qJ6Fgb/installation.png[/img]﻿[/u][/b]
[/b][/u]
- Make sure you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1726]PyTK[/url], and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1254]Custom Furniture[/url] installed as well
- Have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2276]Furniture Anywhere[/url] and Custom Furniture Anywhere as well if you'd like to be able to place these furnitures outside your house
- Download my latest file and unzip it
- Navigate to your "[i]Stardew Valley\Mods"[/i] folder and drop the extracted folder there
- Run the game to generate the config file (just leave it as-is or tweak the options to your liking)
- Have fun :)

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/SxLycR1L/credits.png[/img]

- Thank you [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/5575844]Lumisteria[/url] and blueberry for helping me add 3D perspective to the cat scratching poles/trees/litter boxes
- Fishbowl by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1237]HopeWasHere[/url][/size]

Downloads.Description: Adds A TON of new furniture and overhauls the way the mod was originally coded to make it easier to add extra furniture in the future if need be.
